# Approvals + replay

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P2 · Proven identity](../README.md#phase-2--proven-identity) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:policy-approvals` · **Epic:** [#100](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/100) · **Tickets:** 5 (5M)

Policy changes go through draft, pending and approved states, and changes that widen what agents can do need a second person. Before approving, reviewers see a replay of recent traffic against the draft showing which requests would newly be allowed or denied.

## How we build it

- Tables `policy_drafts` (id, base_version, author, state draft|pending|approved|rejected|applied, body YAML, created_at) and `policy_approvals` (draft_id, approver, decision, comment, at); approval of a draft creates a new version in P1 policy history; base_version mismatch at apply time forces rebase.
- Widening detection in new package internal/approvals: compare base and draft config.Policy; widening = new or broadened allowlist entry (wildcard/regex broadening, new methods/ports), removed denylist entry, removed blockedUsers, relaxed rate limit or time window, identity mode lowered, agent allowed_groups added.
- Two-person rule: widening drafts need approval from an editor/admin other than the author; narrowing-only drafts can be self-applied when `approvals.allowSelfApproveNarrowing: true` (default true). Break-glass bypass is audited and alerts.
- Replay: on submit, run internal/policyeval.Evaluate over the last N events (config `approvals.replayWindow`, default 7d / max 100k) from the fleet store, attach the EvalResult (new_allow/new_deny groups) to the draft; reviewers can re-run.
- Existing dashboard policy edit path (SetPolicyWriter -> WritePolicy) now creates a draft instead of writing directly when approvals are enabled.

## Done when

A widening policy change cannot reach workers until a second editor approves it after seeing its replay diff, and the whole flow is in the admin audit log.

### 1/5 · W-P2-APPR-01

**Add draft and approval store with state machine**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#101](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/101)

Add new package internal/approvals with DraftStore (SQLite tables policy_drafts, policy_approvals) and transitions Submit, Approve, Reject, Apply, Withdraw with guarded state changes in a transaction. Apply calls the P1 policy-history append and s.refresh(); stale base_version returns ErrRebaseRequired.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Illegal transition (approved->draft) rejected
- [ ] Apply on stale base returns ErrRebaseRequired
- [ ] Applied draft produces exactly one new policy version

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-APPR-02`](policy-approvals.md#25--w-p2-appr-02) Implement widening-change detection; [`W-P2-APPR-03`](policy-approvals.md#35--w-p2-appr-03) Attach policyeval replay results to drafts

### 2/5 · W-P2-APPR-02

**Implement widening-change detection**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#102](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/102)

Add `Classify(base, draft config.Policy, baseAgents, draftAgents) Classification{Widening bool, Reasons []string}` in internal/approvals covering allowlist/denylist entries, pattern broadening (literal->wildcard/regex treated as widening), methods/ports, rate limits, time windows, blockedUsers removals and identity mode/allowed_groups changes. Unknown changes are classified widening.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Table test: each widening case flagged with a reason
- [ ] Pure narrowing (new deny entry) not flagged
- [ ] Unrecognized field change defaults to widening

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-APPR-01`](policy-approvals.md#15--w-p2-appr-01) Add draft and approval store with state machine

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-APPR-04`](policy-approvals.md#45--w-p2-appr-04) Enforce two-person rule in approval API

### 3/5 · W-P2-APPR-03

**Attach policyeval replay results to drafts**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#103](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/103)

On Submit, fetch events from the fleet store via FleetStore.GetEvents(EventFilter{Since: now-replayWindow, Limit}) and run policyeval.Evaluate against the draft; store the EvalResult JSON on the draft. Run asynchronously with a 60s timeout; draft shows replay status pending|done|failed and can be re-run via `POST /api/policy/drafts/{id}/replay`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Draft adding a deny shows new_deny groups for matching events
- [ ] Replay timeout marks failed without blocking submit
- [ ] Replay results contain no URLs beyond domain/port/method grouping

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-APPR-01`](policy-approvals.md#15--w-p2-appr-01) Add draft and approval store with state machine

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-APPR-04`](policy-approvals.md#45--w-p2-appr-04) Enforce two-person rule in approval API

### 4/5 · W-P2-APPR-04

**Enforce two-person rule in approval API**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#104](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/104)

Add `/api/policy/drafts` routes (create, submit, approve, reject, apply) in internal/controlplane; approve requires editor/admin role and approver != author when Classification.Widening; narrowing drafts may be self-applied when configured. Route the existing dashboard WritePolicy path through drafts when `approvals.enabled`. Every transition is audited.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Author approving own widening draft returns 403
- [ ] Second editor approval applies the draft and workers receive it
- [ ] Dashboard direct edit creates a draft when approvals enabled

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-APPR-02`](policy-approvals.md#25--w-p2-appr-02) Implement widening-change detection; [`W-P2-APPR-03`](policy-approvals.md#35--w-p2-appr-03) Attach policyeval replay results to drafts
